papers.title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
papers.summary: PDRVLA improves robot action generation by integrating a lightweight physical dynamics module that predicts future visual features with world-model supervision, avoiding online video generation latency.

papers.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
papers.summary: The Trinity framework recursively improves multimodal agents by organizing tasks into a capability tree, generating simulated training worlds, and routing specialized harness modules to boost performance on diverse benchmarks.

papers.title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
papers.summary: Hy-Nomas is a video world model that uses causal attention and structured captions to follow multi-turn text and camera instructions while preserving interaction history.

papers.title: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
papers.summary: HABIT-Bench evaluates whether LLM agent memory systems can infer implicit user habits from sparse dialogue evidence and apply them correctly across long-term interactions.

papers.title: CodeCap-Bench: Can Code Serve as a Good Video Caption?
papers.summary: Executable code representations of video content improve reasoning and reconstruction over natural language, yet current multimodal models still struggle to generate faithful code captions for complex temporal dynamics.

papers.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
papers.summary: Large-scale evaluation reveals that dedicated memory systems often underperform naive retrieval-augmented generation, introducing a framework of memory benefit and memory tax to assess net value.

papers.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
papers.summary: ThinkWorld improves robotic generalization by representing actions as dynamics chains and using world imagination to learn from unlabeled human videos.

papers.title: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
papers.summary: Test-Time Memory Evolution updates external memory without changing model weights to guide scientific discovery more efficiently than test-time training.

papers.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
papers.summary: Factorized Vector Quantization improves discrete visual token quality by using parallel codebooks on complementary feature views, enabling discrete representations to match continuous ones in multimodal understanding.

papers.title: OvisOCR3 Technical Report
papers.summary: OvisOCR3 is a compact 0.8B vision-language model that unifies diverse OCR tasks through multi-teacher distillation and reinforcement learning, achieving state-of-the-art results across document parsing, general OCR, key information extraction, figure captioning, and cross-page table reconstruction.

papers.title: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation
papers.summary: Looped transformers trained with full backpropagation through time outperform truncated alternatives under matched compute, with scaling laws identifying two loops as optimal when model size is adjustable.

papers.title: Channel Selection for Mixture-of-Experts Decoding Needs No Calibration Data
papers.summary: Prox replaces calibrated thresholds with top-k channel selection and a weight-derived reader to accelerate Mixture-of-Experts inference while preserving accuracy.

papers.title: MatAnyone-E: Sparse Memory Propagation for Efficient High-Resolution Video Matting
papers.summary: MatAnyone-E accelerates high-resolution video matting by selectively applying high-resolution matching to uncertain regions and using a lightweight decoder, achieving large speedups with preserved quality.

papers.title: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
papers.summary: VibeVideoBench evaluates multimodal agents that generate videos via code, finding that top systems meet core requirements on most tasks but frequently fail due to poor time management.

papers.title: What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents
papers.summary: Reasoning effort in generative models acts as a credence good where higher compute does not guarantee better instance-level results, and an escalation strategy from low effort improves cost-efficiency.

papers.title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
papers.summary: EvidenceConnect synthesizes training data to strengthen visual evidence connection, improving spatial perception and multimodal reasoning across diverse tasks.

papers.title: Omni-InteractScope: Benchmarking Proactive and Agentic Interaction in Continuous Omnimodal Streams
papers.summary: Omni-InteractScope evaluates continuous audiovisual interaction reliability, revealing that current Omni-LLMs struggle with timely tool use, query-free reminders, and sustained guidance.

papers.title: RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions
papers.summary: RynnWorld-Latent learns cross-embodiment world dynamics via 3D-grounded latent actions, enabling joint pretraining on diverse video sources and synthetic data generation for improved robot policy performance.

papers.title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
papers.summary: Under KL-regularized control, a policy encodes its harness preferences, so deployed performance equals harness potential minus policy mismatch, and harness comparisons must separate these terms to predict training gains.

papers.title: Timestral
papers.summary: Timestral is a family of time series foundation models that achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting through decoupled horizon forecasting, native future covariate support, and synthetic pretraining followed by mixed post-training.

papers.title: Benchmarking Obstacle-Conditioned Safety in Household Robot Navigation
papers.summary: The study introduces a benchmark and metric to evaluate whether robot navigation policies adapt continuous motion to obstacle safety semantics, revealing a gap in translating semantic caution into safe movement.

papers.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
papers.summary: LongChang evaluates whether LLMs can autonomously discover altered physical laws through simulated experimentation, finding that only one model achieved limited success.

papers.title: Vision-Language-Action or World-Action? Just Action Models
papers.summary: Just Action Model decouples backbone initialization, future observation objectives, and inference machinery to improve robot control with foresight training and reduced computation.

papers.title: Learning and Reasoning with Geometry: How Generation Helps Spatial Understanding
papers.summary: GeoUG improves spatial reasoning by combining depth and multi-view generation with adaptive geometric verification during inference.

papers.title: SearchHorizonBench: A Benchmark for Search Value in AI Agents
papers.summary: SearchHorizonBench evaluates how agents learn to estimate the value of additional search from execution history, showing that historical calibration improves prediction accuracy but leaves most search-gain variance unexplained.

papers.title: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
papers.summary: HaMo combines rapid retrieval of procedural experience cards with gradual model adaptation to improve long-horizon web agents' retention and cross-task execution.

papers.title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
papers.summary: When compressing multi-agent discussions for final decisions, memory selection by rarity or relevance both fail due to decoy inclusion and social-proof bias, and even full transcripts reduce accuracy compared to no notes.

papers.title: MoveBench: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Sports and Health Coaching
papers.summary: MoveBench introduces a specialized benchmark for evaluating large language models on sports and health coaching, emphasizing safety, scientific validity, and personalization across multiple-choice and open-ended tasks.

papers.title: MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model
papers.summary: A world model predicts machine learning program outcomes to enable affordable test-time scaling for AI research agents, improving performance with fewer real executions.

papers.title: PhysEvolve: Verifier-grounded Self-evolution for Physical Reasoning with Executable Worlds
papers.summary: Physevolve trains vision-language models in causal physical reasoning by using a physics engine to validate self-generated executable worlds and counterfactual simulations, improving performance on dynamics benchmarks without human data.
